"''Very good… ''Very'' good.|The Clone Commander and Yoda|}} A '''Clone Commander''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Clone Commander]] participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], the opening conflict in the war, leading [[Republic Military|Republic forces]] from a [[Forward Command Center|forward command center]]. When [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]] arrived at the post, the [[commander]] briefed him on the Republic's positions. ==Biography== {{Quote|The droid army is in full retreat.|The Clone Commander, to Yoda|}} [[File:Forward_Command_Center_AotC.png|thumb|left|250px|The Clone Commander served under Grand Master Yoda at the forward command station on Geonosis.]] [[Reproduction|Grown]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] from the [[DNA]] of [[Jango Fett]], a [[bounty hunter]] who became the [[Clone template|template]] of the [[Kaminoan]] [[clone trooper]] [[army]], this [[Cloning|clone]] served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] with the [[military rank]] of [[Clone Commander]]. The clone was one of many [[commander]]s that were specially trained for combat in the pan-[[The galaxy|galactic]] [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] between [[22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' The clone deployed to [[Geonosis]] in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] as part of two full [[Sector Army|sector armies]] During the battle, as Separatist [[core ship]]s began to launch, the commander stood by Yoda watching the battlefield through [[macrobinoculars]] as Yoda commanded a [[Unidentified Clone Captain (Geonosis)|clone captain]] to have their forces concentrate all their fire on the nearest [[starship]]. After the ship plummeted and struck the ground and Yoda sensed Skywalker's troubles through [[the Force]], the commander reported to the [[Jedi]] that all Separatist forces were in full retreat. Yoda confirmed, and asked the commander to request a ship so that he may assist Skywalker and Kenobi in confronting the Separatist [[Head of State]], [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Well done, Commander. Bring me a ship.|Yoda, to the Clone Commander|}} [[File:Clone_Commander_and_Yoda-AOTC.png|thumb|right|250px|The Clone Commander obeyed Yoda's orders without question.]] As with all clones of the Republic, the commander was cloned from the genetic template of the [[human]] bounty hunter Jango Fett. Consequently, the clone was 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|ft]]) in height, weighed eighty [[kilogram]]s, and had [[Color|tan]] skin. Like all clone [[trooper]]s, the commander was designed for loyalty and obedience. [[Kaminoan]] [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]] assured Obi-Wan Kenobi that the clones would obey any order without question. During the battle on Geonosis, the commander executed their duty as a [[clone trooper officer]], monitoring the clone army's progress on the battlefield and reporting to Yoda. The Grand Master commended the commander for their leadership, and ordered them to summon a [[transport]] to which the commander complied. ==Equipment== The commander wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor]], with [[Color|yellow]] markings on their [[armor]] that signified their military rank in the Grand Army of the Republic.{{Databank|clone-trooper-armor|Clone Trooper Armor}} As a clone, the commander was implanted with a [[behavioral modification biochip]] at birth to ensure that they would not resist certain [[Executive Order Codes for the Grand Army of the Republic|orders]]. ==Behind the scenes== The clone first appeared in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. They were voiced by actor [[Temuera Morrison]]. ==Appearances== *{{Film|II}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Clone trooper commanders]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
